name: Mana Surges
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
We are almost finished, but this last step is the most perilous, adventurer.

I have the empty summoner's orb and am ready to empower it.  We will do this by harnessing the energy of a mana rift.  I'll cast a spell that will temporarily open a rift, from which creatures, mana surges, will pour out.  You must defeat the mana surges and their power will be released, which I will then collect.

Kill enough mana surges before the rift closes and I will place all their collected energy in your orb.
narrative.objectives: Kill 12 Mana Surges in the allowed time limit.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You did it!  I never doubted you for a second!  Ok, maybe for just a second, or two... but basically I didn't have much doubt.

Honest.
narrative.requestItemsText: You have not killed the required amount of mana surges, adventurer.
